domains.name: Sales
workflow: An opportunity is ready to close, but a requested delivery date conflicts with the current plan.
Twin assembles the proposal, customer conversation and delivery dependency into options for the account team.
The sales owner reviews the commitment with delivery before approving a revised proposal.

domains.name: Marketing
workflow: A launch campaign is receiving attention but generating fewer qualified conversations than expected.
Twin compares the brief, audience feedback and channel evidence, then prepares messaging and distribution options.
The campaign owner approves the revised plan and any changes to spend or publishing.

domains.name: Content
workflow: A writer needs to refresh an article after product messaging changes.
Twin gathers the existing article, revised brief, approved product references and unresolved reviewer comments.
The editor verifies the claims and approves the revised asset before publication.

domains.name: Customer Support
workflow: A customer reports an issue that has already crossed support and engineering.
Twin brings together the case history, attempted fixes, related issue and promised follow-up.
The support owner reviews the response and authorizes the customer communication or escalation.

domains.name: Product & Engineering
workflow: A release has an unresolved issue affecting a customer commitment.
Twin connects the release goal, issue history, technical dependency and customer impact into delivery options.
The product and engineering owners decide the release scope and authorize the next action.

domains.name: Human Resources
workflow: A new employee starts next week and several onboarding dependencies remain open.
Twin prepares the approved onboarding plan, responsible teams and outstanding tasks from permitted information.
HR and the relevant owners review the plan; access changes follow their authorization process.

domains.name: Legal
workflow: A customer requests a contract exception before signing.
Twin assembles the proposed change, approved terms, business reason and earlier review comments.
The authorized legal and commercial reviewers decide the exception; AI preparation does not replace legal advice.

domains.name: Memory & Knowledge
workflow: A new team owner needs to understand why a project changed direction.
Twin gathers the permitted decision record, source evidence, previous tradeoffs and unresolved questions.
The owner checks the references and confirms which conclusions remain valid before proceeding.

domains.name: Account Success
workflow: A customer reaches an onboarding milestone with a delivery dependency still unresolved.
Twin prepares the agreed goal, adoption evidence, support history and responsible teams for the account review.
The account owner agrees the next step with the customer and approves any consequential communication.

domains.name: Finance
workflow: A supplier invoice differs from the approved purchase and delivery record.
Twin compares the invoice, purchase order, terms and receipt evidence, then prepares the unresolved questions.
The finance owner decides the exception and authorizes any payment or source-record correction.

domains.name: Finance Leadership
workflow: Leadership needs to review a hiring proposal against a revised cash outlook.
Twin assembles the operating plan, cash assumptions, cost commitments and alternative allocation options.
The finance leader reviews the assumptions and the authorized executives decide the budget commitment.

domains.name: Founders & CXOs
workflow: A growth target conflicts with current delivery capacity and budget.
Twin prepares the revenue assumptions, capacity constraints, resource options and earlier decisions.
The leadership team chooses the tradeoff and authorizes the resulting commitments.

domains.name: Personal Work
workflow: You return to a project after several meetings and a tool change.
Twin prepares your permitted notes, files, outstanding commitments and the previous checkpoint.
You choose the next priority and approve any message or consequential update.

domains.name: Operations
workflow: A delivery handoff is blocked by an unresolved dependency in another team.
Twin gathers the commitment, task history, affected work and responsible owners into escalation options.
The operations owner approves the revised handoff and coordinates the agreed actions.

domains.name: Revenue Operations
workflow: A signed deal has a billing discrepancy and an unclear onboarding owner.
Twin relates the CRM record, approved terms, invoice and handoff history to prepare the discrepancies.
Revenue operations coordinates the authorized owners before a billing correction or customer update.

domains.name: SaaS
workflow: A customer reports low adoption alongside a recurring product issue.
Twin prepares the available usage evidence, support pattern, subscription context and product dependency.
The account and product owners agree the response and authorize the customer-facing next step.

domains.name: Service Delivery
workflow: A client requests additional work while a delivery milestone is at risk.
Twin prepares the agreed scope, new request, affected dependencies and options for delivery.
The engagement owner approves the scope or schedule change with the client.

domains.name: Professional Services
workflow: An engagement review finds work recorded outside the agreed billable scope.
Twin compares the engagement terms, time records, delivered work and client approval history.
The engagement and finance owners review the evidence before approving a billing adjustment.

domains.name: Manufacturing
workflow: A quality exception affects a batch needed for a committed delivery.
Twin assembles the inspection evidence, batch history, supplier context and affected orders.
The quality and operations owners decide the disposition and authorize the revised delivery plan.

domains.name: Retail & Ecommerce
workflow: Several returns involve the same product while replacement stock is constrained.
Twin compares return reasons, product context, available inventory and affected customer cases.
The retail owner reviews the evidence and approves any replenishment, refund or customer outreach.
